welcome
Hi, I'm Dani. Welcome to Vegans Explore. I'll be your guide.
reached

If you lead a Vegan nonprofit, a rescue or a sanctuary, you probably have a thousand ideas and not enough hands. Passion keeps the doors open, but it can't do the fundraising, the marketing and the day-to-day on its own. And the people who help steer the ship often get pulled somewhere else. Our founder has worked alongside hundreds of organizations, and we built this so you don't have to do it alone. You go from carrying everything yourself to having a home base, a playbook and a community behind you.
tips
The ten tips cover fundraising and staying relevant, one at a time, each with what to do this week.
pulse
Pulse has our conversations with nonprofit leaders. Hear how they did it, right here.
directory

The Directory is where members find nonprofits, rescues and sanctuaries, city by city. Get found shows you how to claim your page and keep it current. If anyone sees something wrong with a listing, they can tell our team, and we look into it.
businesses
Businesses shows Vegan brands and restaurants near you that fit a partnership, with a pitch you can send.
events
Events puts your next event on our calendar and in the Daily Pulse. Need a foster? Post it on your city's Fosters board, where local members are looking.
support
Support covers what wears small teams down, and how to share the load.
partner
And when you're ready, Become a Partner gives your organization its own link, points for our services and a badge.
start
